+extends Area2D
+class_name Seal
+
+@export var speed: float = 320.0
+var velocity: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
+@onready var sprite: Sprite2D = $Sprite2D
+var half_width: float = 32.0
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	# calculate half width from sprite texture if available
+	if sprite and sprite.texture:
+		half_width = sprite.texture.get_size().x * 0.5
+	else:
+		half_width = 32.0
+	# connect body entered
+	if not is_connected("body_entered", Callable(self, "_on_body_entered")):
+		connect("body_entered", Callable(self, "_on_body_entered"))
+
+func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
+	var dir := 0
+	if Input.is_action_pressed("move_left"):
+		dir -= 1
+	if Input.is_action_pressed("move_right"):
+		dir += 1
+	velocity.x = dir * speed
+	# Print one line per press
+	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("move_left"):
+		print("MOVE LEFT")
+	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("move_right"):
+		print("MOVE RIGHT")
+	# Apply movement
+	position.x += velocity.x * delta
+	# Clamp to screen edges
+	var vp_size: Vector2 = get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
+	position.x = clamp(position.x, half_width, vp_size.x - half_width)
+
+func get_velocity() -> Vector2:
+	return velocity
+
+func reset_to_start() -> void:
+	var vp_size: Vector2 = get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
+	position = Vector2(vp_size.x * 0.5, vp_size.y - 60)
+	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
+
+func _on_body_entered(body: Node) -> void:
+	# Called when the ball (RigidBody2D) enters the seal area
+	if body and body.has_method("bounce_from_seal"):
+		body.bounce_from_seal(velocity.x)
+		# Increment score via the GameManager (root scene)
+		var gm = get_tree().get_current_scene()
+		if gm and gm.has_method("increment_score"):
+			gm.increment_score()

--- game/beach_ball.gd
+++ game/beach_ball.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,78 @@
+extends Node2D
+class_name BeachBall
+
+@export var radius: float = 16.0
+@export var initial_speed: float = 220.0
+var velocity: Vector2 = Vector2(150, -200)
+var angular_velocity: float = 0.0
+var active: bool = true
+@onready var sprite: Sprite2D = $Sprite2D
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	# set sprite origin if available
+	if sprite and sprite.texture:
+		radius = max(8.0, sprite.texture.get_size().x * 0.5)
+
+func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if not active:
+		return
+	# simple physics integration
+	position += velocity * delta
+	rotation += angular_velocity * delta
+	# screen bounds
+	var vp_size: Vector2 = get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
+	# left/right bounce
+	if position.x - radius <= 0 and velocity.x < 0:
+		position.x = radius
+		velocity.x = -velocity.x
+		angular_velocity = -angular_velocity * 0.8
+		# preserve momentum
+	elif position.x + radius >= vp_size.x and velocity.x > 0:
+		position.x = vp_size.x - radius
+		velocity.x = -velocity.x
+		angular_velocity = -angular_velocity * 0.8
+	# top bounce
+	if position.y - radius <= 0 and velocity.y < 0:
+		position.y = radius
+		velocity.y = -velocity.y
+		angular_velocity *= 0.9
+	# check fall past seal -> game over
+	var gm = get_tree().get_current_scene()
+	if gm and gm.has_node("Seal"):
+		var seal = gm.get_node("Seal")
+		if position.y - radius > seal.position.y:
+			# ball fell past seal
+			if gm.has_method("game_over"):
+				gm.game_over()
+			# stop the ball
+			stop()
+
+func bounce_from_seal(seal_vel_x: float) -> void:
+	# Called by Seal when the ball hits the seal's nose area.
+	# Reflect vertical velocity and add influence from seal's horizontal velocity.
+	if not active:
+		return
+	velocity.y = -abs(velocity.y) if velocity.y > 0 else -abs(velocity.y)
+	velocity.y = -abs(velocity.y) if velocity.y >= 0 else velocity.y
+	velocity.y = -abs(velocity.y)
+	# give a minimum upward speed
+	velocity.y = min(velocity.y, -150)
+	# add seal horizontal momentum to ball's x velocity
+	velocity.x += seal_vel_x * 0.5
+	# limit speed
+	if velocity.length() > 800:
+		velocity = velocity.normalized() * 800
+	# spin based on seal movement
+	angular_velocity += seal_vel_x * 0.02
+
+func stop() -> void:
+	active = false
+	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
+	angular_velocity = 0.0
+
+func reset_to_start() -> void:
+	var vp_size: Vector2 = get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
+	position = Vector2(vp_size.x * 0.5 + 60, vp_size.y * 0.5 - 100)
+	velocity = Vector2(initial_speed, -initial_speed)
+	angular_velocity = 0.0
+	active = true

+	ball.reset_to_start()

+	game_over_label.visible = false

Implementation contract (short):

- Requirement -> owning files:
  - Window title (0): game/game_manager.gd (sets OS.set_window_title)
  - Seal display & movement & edge clamp (1,2,3): game/seal.gd (+ main.tscn for sprite)
  - Ball physics, bouncing, spin, wall rebounds, scoring, game over detection (4,5,7,8,9,10): game/beach_ball.gd
  - Background color, HUD, score display, restart, quit, game over UI, input mapping, prints (6,11,12,13,14,15,16,17): game/game_manager.gd and interactions with seal/beach_ball
  - Single-scene requirement (19) enforced by using only game/main.tscn root scene.

- State ownership and interfaces:
  - game_manager.gd (Node2D): owns game state (score:int, is_running:bool), UI nodes, input mapping, restart/quit functions.
    - Methods: increment_score() -> void, game_over() -> void, restart_game() -> void.
  - seal.gd (Area2D): owns horizontal position, reads Input to move. Exports speed: float. Provides get_velocity() -> Vector2 (current horizontal velocity).
  - beach_ball.gd (RigidBody2D): owns ball kinematics: linear_velocity (Vector2) and angular_velocity (float), active flag. Method bounce_from_seal(seal_vel_x:float) -> void to adjust velocity when seal hits it. Detects wall collisions and checks for falling past seal; calls game_manager.game_over() when appropriate.

- Shared interfaces:
  - Ball calls get_tree().get_current_scene() as GameManager to call game_over()/notify; GameManager exposes increment_score(), game_over(), restart_game().
  - Seal on body_entered will call body.bounce_from_seal(seal_velocity.x) and request game_manager.increment_score().

- Coordinate convention:
  - Screen origin top-left, +y down. Positions in pixels. Seal positioned near bottom (y ~ 560). Sprite centers used for positioning.

- Lifecycle:
  - init: main.tscn _ready sets input actions, window title, places seal and ball.
  - run: Seal responds to LEFT/RIGHT input and prints MOVE LEFT/RIGHT when moving; Ball moves under physics code and bounces off top/left/right and when hit by seal's Area2D nose; GameManager updates score and HUD.
  - game over: when ball.y > seal.y + 32 -> game_over() called: ball stops, "GAME OVER" shown, print "GAME OVER".
  - restart: pressing R calls restart_game(): resets positions, score, re-enables ball, prints "RESTART".
  - quit: pressing Escape prints "QUIT" and quits.

I'll create the Godot project file, main scene, and the three scripts plus __init__.py.

For each requirement trace: player input -> action -> world/state change -> rule check ->
visible/stdout feedback. Cover the lifecycle init -> run -> win/lose (play frozen) ->
reset (every object, counter, timer, velocity restored) -> quit. Decide who owns each piece of

@export var initial_speed: float = 220.0
var velocity: Vector2 = Vector2(150, -200)
var angular_velocity: float = 0.0
var active: bool = true
@onready var sprite: Sprite2D = $Sprite2D

func _ready() -> void:
	# set sprite origin if available
	if sprite and sprite.texture:
		radius = max(8.0, sprite.texture.get_size().x * 0.5)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not active:
		return
	# simple physics integration
	position += velocity * delta
	rotation += angular_velocity * delta
	# screen bounds
	var vp_size: Vector2 = get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	# left/right bounce
	if position.x - radius <= 0 and velocity.x < 0:
		position.x = radius
		velocity.x = -velocity.x
		angular_velocity = -angular_velocity * 0.8
		# preserve momentum
	elif position.x + radius >= vp_size.x and velocity.x > 0:
		position.x = vp_size.x - radius
		velocity.x = -velocity.x
		angular_velocity = -angular_velocity * 0.8
	# top bounce
	if position.y - radius <= 0 and velocity.y < 0:
		position.y = radius
		velocity.y = -velocity.y
		angular_velocity *= 0.9
	# check fall past seal -> game over
	var gm = get_tree().get_current_scene()
	if gm and gm.has_node("Seal"):
		var seal = gm.get_node("Seal")
		if position.y - radius > seal.position.y:
			# ball fell past seal
			if gm.has_method("game_over"):
				gm.game_over()
			# stop the ball
			stop()

func bounce_from_seal(seal_vel_x: float) -> void:
	# Called by Seal when the ball hits the seal's nose area.
	# Reflect vertical velocity and add influence from seal's horizontal velocity.
	if not active:
		return
	velocity.y = -abs(velocity.y) if velocity.y > 0 else -abs(velocity.y)
	velocity.y = -abs(velocity.y) if velocity.y >= 0 else velocity.y
	velocity.y = -abs(velocity.y)
	# give a minimum upward speed
	velocity.y = min(velocity.y, -150)
	# add seal horizontal momentum to ball's x velocity
	velocity.x += seal_vel_x * 0.5
	# limit speed
	if velocity.length() > 800:
		velocity = velocity.normalized() * 800
	# spin based on seal movement
	angular_velocity += seal_vel_x * 0.02

func stop() -> void:
	active = false
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	angular_velocity = 0.0

func reset_to_start() -> void:
	var vp_size: Vector2 = get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	position = Vector2(vp_size.x * 0.5 + 60, vp_size.y * 0.5 - 100)
	velocity = Vector2(initial_speed, -initial_speed)
	angular_velocity = 0.0
	active = true

extends Area2D
class_name Seal

@export var speed: float = 320.0
var velocity: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
@onready var sprite: Sprite2D = get_node_or_null("Sprite2D") as Sprite2D
var half_width: float = 32.0

func _ready() -> void:
	# calculate half width from sprite texture if available
	if sprite and sprite.texture:
		half_width = sprite.texture.get_size().x * 0.5
	else:
		half_width = 32.0
	# connect body entered
	if not is_connected("body_entered", Callable(self, "_on_body_entered")):
		connect("body_entered", Callable(self, "_on_body_entered"))

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	var dir := 0
	if Input.is_action_pressed("move_left"):
		dir -= 1
	if Input.is_action_pressed("move_right"):
		dir += 1
	velocity.x = dir * speed
	# Print one line per press
	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("move_left"):
		print("MOVE LEFT")
	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("move_right"):
		print("MOVE RIGHT")
	# Apply movement
	position.x += velocity.x * delta
	# Clamp to screen edges
	var vp_size: Vector2 = get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	position.x = clamp(position.x, half_width, vp_size.x - half_width)

func get_velocity() -> Vector2:
	return velocity

func reset_to_start() -> void:
	var vp_size: Vector2 = get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	position = Vector2(vp_size.x * 0.5, vp_size.y - 60)
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO

func _on_body_entered(body: Node) -> void:
	# Called when the ball (RigidBody2D) enters the seal area
	if body and body.has_method("bounce_from_seal"):
		body.bounce_from_seal(velocity.x)
		# Increment score via the GameManager (root scene)
		var gm = get_tree().get_current_scene()
		if gm and gm.has_method("increment_score"):
			gm.increment_score()

extends Node2D
class_name BeachBall

@export var radius: float = 16.0
@export var initial_speed: float = 220.0
var velocity: Vector2 = Vector2(150, -200)
var angular_velocity: float = 0.0
var active: bool = true
@onready var sprite: Sprite2D = get_node_or_null("Sprite2D") as Sprite2D

func _ready() -> void:
	# set sprite origin if available
	if sprite and sprite.texture:
		radius = max(8.0, sprite.texture.get_size().x * 0.5)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not active:
		return
	# simple physics integration
	position += velocity * delta
	rotation += angular_velocity * delta
	# screen bounds
	var vp_size: Vector2 = get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	# left/right bounce
	if position.x - radius <= 0 and velocity.x < 0:
		position.x = radius
		velocity.x = -velocity.x
		angular_velocity = -angular_velocity * 0.8
		# preserve momentum
	elif position.x + radius >= vp_size.x and velocity.x > 0:
		position.x = vp_size.x - radius
		velocity.x = -velocity.x
		angular_velocity = -angular_velocity * 0.8
	# top bounce
	if position.y - radius <= 0 and velocity.y < 0:
		position.y = radius
		velocity.y = -velocity.y
		angular_velocity *= 0.9
	# collision with seal (manual detection)
	var gm = get_tree().get_current_scene()
	if gm and gm.has_node("Seal"):
		var seal = gm.get_node("Seal")
		# compute seal top (seal sprite is centered)
		var seal_sprite: Sprite2D = null
		if seal.has_node("Sprite2D"):
			seal_sprite = seal.get_node("Sprite2D")
		var seal_half_w = 32.0
		var seal_top_y = seal.position.y
		if seal_sprite and seal_sprite.texture:
			seal_half_w = seal_sprite.texture.get_size().x * 0.5
			seal_top_y = seal.position.y - (seal_sprite.texture.get_size().y * 0.5)
		# only collide when ball is moving downwards and crossing seal top
		if velocity.y > 0 and position.y + radius >= seal_top_y and position.y - radius < seal.position.y:
			# check horizontal overlap
			if abs(position.x - seal.position.x) <= (seal_half_w + radius):
				# perform bounce and score
				var seal_vel_x = 0.0
				if seal.has_method("get_velocity"):
					seal_vel_x = seal.get_velocity().x
				# adjust position to avoid sticking
				position.y = seal_top_y - radius - 1
				bounce_from_seal(seal_vel_x)
				if gm.has_method("increment_score"):
					gm.increment_score()
		# check fall past seal -> game over
		if position.y - radius > seal.position.y:
			# ball fell past seal
			if gm.has_method("game_over"):
				gm.game_over()
			# stop the ball
			stop()

func bounce_from_seal(seal_vel_x: float) -> void:
	# Called by Seal when the ball hits the seal's nose area.
	# Reflect vertical velocity and add influence from seal's horizontal velocity.
	if not active:
		return
	velocity.y = -abs(velocity.y) if velocity.y > 0 else -abs(velocity.y)
	velocity.y = -abs(velocity.y) if velocity.y >= 0 else velocity.y
	velocity.y = -abs(velocity.y)
	# give a minimum upward speed
	velocity.y = min(velocity.y, -150)
	# add seal horizontal momentum to ball's x velocity
	velocity.x += seal_vel_x * 0.5
	# limit speed
	if velocity.length() > 800:
		velocity = velocity.normalized() * 800
	# spin based on seal movement
	angular_velocity += seal_vel_x * 0.02

func stop() -> void:
	active = false
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	angular_velocity = 0.0

func reset_to_start() -> void:
	var vp_size: Vector2 = get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	position = Vector2(vp_size.x * 0.5 + 60, vp_size.y * 0.5 - 100)
	velocity = Vector2(initial_speed, -initial_speed)
	angular_velocity = 0.0
	active = true

extends Node2D
class_name GameManager

var score: int = 0
var is_running: bool = true

@onready var seal: Node = null
@onready var ball: Node = null
@onready var score_label: Label = $CanvasLayer/ScoreLabel
@onready var game_over_label: Label = $CanvasLayer/GameOverLabel

func _ready() -> void:
	# Window title
	DisplayServer.window_set_title("Seal Bounce")
	# Ensure input actions exist
	_setup_input()
	# find nodes
	seal = $Seal
	ball = $BeachBall
	# init positions
	seal.reset_to_start()
	ball.reset_to_start()
	_update_score_label()
	game_over_label.visible = false

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
		print("RESTART")
		restart_game()
	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit"):
		print("QUIT")
		get_tree().quit()

func _setup_input() -> void:
	# movement
	if not InputMap.has_action("move_left"):
		InputMap.add_action("move_left")
		var ev := InputEventKey.new()
		ev.physical_keycode = KEY_LEFT
		InputMap.action_add_event("move_left", ev)
	# also add A
	var ev2 := InputEventKey.new()
	ev2.physical_keycode = KEY_A
	InputMap.action_add_event("move_left", ev2)

	if not InputMap.has_action("move_right"):
		InputMap.add_action("move_right")
		var ev3 := InputEventKey.new()
		ev3.physical_keycode = KEY_RIGHT
		InputMap.action_add_event("move_right", ev3)
	var ev4 := InputEventKey.new()
	ev4.physical_keycode = KEY_D
	InputMap.action_add_event("move_right", ev4)

	# restart
	if not InputMap.has_action("restart"):
		InputMap.add_action("restart")
		var evr := InputEventKey.new()
		evr.physical_keycode = KEY_R
		InputMap.action_add_event("restart", evr)
	# quit
	if not InputMap.has_action("quit"):
		InputMap.add_action("quit")
		var evq := InputEventKey.new()
		evq.physical_keycode = KEY_ESCAPE
		InputMap.action_add_event("quit", evq)

func increment_score() -> void:
	score += 1
	_update_score_label()

func _update_score_label() -> void:
	score_label.text = str(score)

func game_over() -> void:
	if not is_running:
		return
	is_running = false
	print("GAME OVER")
	# show label and stop ball
	game_over_label.visible = true
	if ball and ball.has_method("stop"):
		ball.stop()

func restart_game() -> void:
	is_running = true
	score = 0
	_update_score_label()
	game_over_label.visible = false
	# reset positions
	if seal and seal.has_method("reset_to_start"):
		seal.reset_to_start()
	if ball and ball.has_method("reset_to_start"):
		ball.reset_to_start()
